listening.beta_quality_acceptance: User requested releasing the existing training process and finishing LLVC on October 21, 2026. This accepts the current experimental quality for Beta availability; it does not claim improved quality or completed technical qualification.

reviews.interpretation: Preference between these two experimental samples; not final quality or release acceptance.

reviews.user_response: Target 1462 seemed the most convincing although it is still plainly AI. 1272 was the worst and sounded much more robotic and target 1673 was somewhere in the middle.
reviews.interpretation: 1462 is the preferred experimental candidate; artificial and robotic sound remains a quality concern. Relative preference does not establish final listening acceptance, intelligibility, or absence of chopped syllables.

reviews.user_response: Teacher sounds acceptable; LLVC makes it worse
reviews.interpretation: Prioritize LLVC duration experiments while holding teacher, paired data and initialization fixed. This identifies the perceived degradation stage, not its underlying cause or final release acceptance.
No perceived improvement from doubling LLVC updates with the teacher and data fixed. Do not advance this unchanged recipe to 5,000 updates. Investigate training context and recipe differences first.

No perceived improvement from the longer generator context at the tested budget. Neither duration nor context experiments establish a quality fix. Retain both as negative results; do not advance budgets or accept the recipe based on numerical parity.

On identical held-out source speech, the reviewer finds the untouched pretrained voice cleaner than the adapted candidates. This implicates adaptation quality rather than establishing an inherent LLVC quality ceiling. Different target identities remain a confound; the specific training defect is not established.

No perceived improvement from discriminator-only warm-up under the tested conditions. Duration, context and warm-up experiments have not established a quality fix. Retain negative results; do not promote warm-up or escalate this recipe based on numerical checks.

comparison.interpretation: Weight changes confirm training changed the model; they do not establish perceptual improvement. The pretrained target identity differs from 1462.

alignment.method: Three-band log-energy envelope correlation, 5 ms resolution, +/-200 ms search
alignment.interpretation: Heuristic timing estimates, not phoneme alignment or proof of a training defect. No audio modified.

adversarial.note: Evaluation-mode output and parameter gradients on three held-out center segments, before clipping or Adam preconditioning. Fresh discriminator is independently seeded, not reconstruction of original initialization. Ratios/cosines do not prove perceptual causation.

warmup.joint_optimizer_policy: Fresh optimizers and restored pre-warm-up RNG; only discriminator weights carry forward
